components.name: Chart/Beeswarm
components.description: Every individual value as a dot, grouped by category and spread so none overlap — shows distribution and outliers without hiding the count. 20–300 points per group; for more use a histogram. React: <BeeswarmChart data={[{ group, value }]} />
